evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never says 'Great, it looks like we have availability within your time frame... This will take about 10 to 15 minutes, and you can walk away with a quote you can depend on.' Instead jumps directly into confirming contact info and the booking confusion.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks 'do you have any questions or concerns you would like answered on this call?' — this comes after confirming contact details, which is technically after some discovery context, but before the full probing section begins. Not cleanly before all logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raises concern about dismantling/disassembly charges; rep does respond and clarify ('it's just everything's included... if you were to need things disassembled that would actually take more time'), but this is clarification of a fee concern, not a two-layer discovery probe into a customer-stated concern. N/A because the customer's only 'concern' is a transactional clarification, not an agenda item.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection summary offered. Rep answers the dismantling question but does not summarize back what was heard. N/A because no broader concerns were raised.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep gathers: property type (apartment), floor (third floor), elevator access, items (20 boxes, bed, sofa/loveseat, table, 2 standing desks, 2 dining chairs), no TV. Does not ask: number of rooms, walking distance to destination (though customer volunteers '10 minutes down the road'), additional rooms, or other special considerations. Partial.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides: 'a typical move this size usually takes three and a half to five and a half hours... I would look to for it to take between three and four hours, and I would look to budget between $606 and if we were to hit that four hour, it would be $808.' Also personalizes to minimal items and customer's own comparison ('you've just got those minimal items'). Full.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep discloses hourly rate ($202 for two movers and 126 box truck), no hidden fees, trip fee/overnight fee structure, and 2.5-hour minimum with 15-minute increments clearly stated. Full.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' Instead moves directly to 'Would you like to get on the schedule or I can go ahead email all this information over to you.' Not asked.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Rep mentions 'on time guarantee' once in the middle of a long feature dump ('And then finally we do have our on time guarantee the way the clock works is the time starts as soon as we get on site open that contract...') but never clarifies the discount terms or how it works if late. None.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Rep states: 'we do have our no worries damage coverage. Which is our free evaluation coverage included in the hourly rate provides up to $2,000 per move to repair replace or reimburse for accidental damages.' Covers $2,000 and 'included in the hourly rate' (no add-on framing), but does not explicitly state 'no deductible / no fine print.' Partial.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar. The conversation moves to estimate discussion without a loop-close on the Two Promises section.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep never asks 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or any genuine final-concerns version. Not asked.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep does not ask 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' Not asked.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep says 'Would you like to get on the schedule or I can go ahead email all this information over to you so you have it.' This is softened with an easy out ('or I can go ahead email...'). With_out.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: No mention of rate lock or no-deposit language tied to booking confirmation.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Rep confirms date (October 11th), email (Daya A-W web @gmail.com), phone number (972-849-2369). Does not confirm arrival window, crew size, both addresses (origin confirmed, destination not explicitly confirmed as a booking detail), or notes about customer concerns for the crew. Partial.

top_strength: Rep handled a confusing booking-system error gracefully, quickly pivoted to discovery, and delivered a clear, anchored estimate with transparent hourly rate and fee structure.
coaching_note: Skip the feature dump in Section 1/2 and commit to the genuine quid pro quo framing ('10-15 minutes, walk away with a quote you can depend on') — that's your contract with the customer, and it never happened here; also never ask 'Does that feel fair?' after pricing, which is essential silence-discipline before closing.
